architecture_notes: Each sub-agent has exactly one output file, completes in ≤10 minutes, reads committed files as inputs, and commits one output file as its handoff. Each phase ends with a qa_agent review sub-agent that must PASS before the next phase starts.

phases.description: Establish the foundational creative vision. Seven focused sub-agents produce the complete story and concept foundation. Each sub-agent owns exactly one output document.

sub_agents.name: high_concept_agent
sub_agents.title: High Concept Document Author
sub_agents.description: Write the one-page High Concept Document for the game.
completion_criteria: One-page pitch with working title, logline, genre, tone, and core pillars
Target audience and platform clearly stated
Unique selling points listed (minimum 3)

sub_agents.name: world_lore_agent
sub_agents.title: World Lore Bible Author
sub_agents.description: Write the World Lore Bible: world history, geography, and major factions.
completion_criteria: 500+ word world history from founding era to present day
Geography section with at least 6 named regions
At least 4 factions with goals, leaders, and relationships to each other

sub_agents.name: race_profiles_agent
sub_agents.title: Playable Race Profiles Author
sub_agents.description: Write the profiles for all 5 playable races.
completion_criteria: 5 races, each with origin, culture, stat tendency (primary/secondary), innate ability, and lore hook
Races are distinct and tied to world lore
Each race has at least one unique passive or active innate ability named

sub_agents.name: story_arc_agent
sub_agents.title: 3-Act Story Arc Author
sub_agents.description: Write the 3-act main story arc outline.
completion_criteria: Act 1 covers inciting incident and party formation
Act 2 covers midpoint twist and escalating conflict
Act 3 covers climax and resolution
Main antagonist motivation is clearly defined
At least 3 named locations per act

sub_agents.name: character_roster_agent
sub_agents.title: Main Character Roster Author
sub_agents.description: Write full profiles for the main party characters and primary villain.
completion_criteria: Minimum 6 playable characters with name, race, class, backstory, and personality
Primary villain profile with motivation and role in each act
Each character has at least 3 lines of sample dialogue

sub_agents.name: sidequest_hooks_agent
sub_agents.title: Sidequest Hooks Author
sub_agents.description: Write the sidequest ideas list (15+ hooks).
completion_criteria: 15 or more sidequest hooks
Each hook has a title, location, giver NPC, and 1-paragraph summary
At least 3 sidequests deepen a party member's backstory

sub_agents.name: phase_1_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 1 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 1 documents for narrative consistency, completeness, and quality before Phase 2 begins. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 6 Phase 1 documents reviewed
Report includes a PASS or FAIL verdict for each document
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 2 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Translate story and concept into formal mechanical design. Eight focused sub-agents each produce one section of the GDD.

sub_agents.name: combat_system_agent
sub_agents.title: Combat System Designer
sub_agents.description: Write the complete Combat System Specification.
completion_criteria: Turn order formula with example calculation
Action menu structure (attack, skill, magic, item, defend, flee)
Damage calculation formula with all variables defined
Status effect list with 10+ effects, each with duration and trigger rules
Hit/miss/critical rate formulas

sub_agents.name: skill_system_agent
sub_agents.title: Skill System Designer
sub_agents.description: Write the Skill System Design document including skill trees per class.
completion_criteria: At least 4 playable classes defined
Each class has a skill tree with 10+ skills
Each skill has: name, MP cost, power rating, unlock level, targeting, and description
Passive and active skills distinguished

sub_agents.name: magic_system_agent
sub_agents.title: Magic System Designer
sub_agents.description: Write the Magic System Design document covering all elemental schools and spell tiers.
completion_criteria: 6 elemental schools defined with lore and mechanical theme
3 spell tiers (I, II, III) per school minimum
AoE rules for each tier
Status effect riders per school
Elemental affinity matrix (strengths and weaknesses)

sub_agents.name: race_abilities_agent
sub_agents.title: Race Ability Tables Author
sub_agents.description: Write the Race Ability Tables defining all innate passives and actives per race.
completion_criteria: All 5 races have a stat growth array (HP, MP, ATK, DEF, MAG, SPD)
Each race has at least 2 innate passives and 1 innate active ability
Abilities are mechanically defined (not just named)

sub_agents.name: progression_curve_agent
sub_agents.title: Progression Curve Designer
sub_agents.description: Write the Progression Curve Document covering XP tables and stat growth.
completion_criteria: XP-to-level table for levels 1-50
Stat growth per level per class (at minimum levels 1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50)
Power spike analysis with no unvalidated spikes before endgame
Item and equipment tier breakpoints defined

sub_agents.name: item_taxonomy_agent
sub_agents.title: Item & Equipment Taxonomy Author
sub_agents.description: Write the Item and Equipment Taxonomy document.
completion_criteria: Item categories defined (consumable, equipment, key item, material)
Equipment slots: weapon, armor, accessory x2
At least 30 named items with stat modifiers, rarity, and shop availability
Crafting recipe list (10+ recipes)

sub_agents.name: enemy_roster_agent
sub_agents.title: Enemy Roster Designer
sub_agents.description: Write the Enemy Design Roster (30+ enemy types with full stats).
completion_criteria: 30+ enemy types defined
Each enemy has: name, zone, level range, HP, MP, ATK, DEF, MAG, SPD, skills (1-3), elemental affinities, and drop table
At least 7 boss enemies, one per major story chapter
Enemy AI behavior patterns noted (aggressive, defensive, support, etc.)

sub_agents.name: phase_2_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 2 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 2 GDD documents for mechanical consistency, balance, and completeness. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 7 Phase 2 documents reviewed
Balance audit: no ability or spell is clearly overpowered for its unlock level
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 3 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Implement all designed systems in Godot 4 using GDScript. 13 focused sub-agents each produce exactly one GDScript file or scene file.

sub_agents.name: battle_manager_agent
sub_agents.title: BattleManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the BattleManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Turn queue sorting by SPD stat
Action resolution: attack, skill, magic, item, defend, flee
Damage calculation matching spec formula
Win/lose condition checking
Signals emitted for all state changes (battle_started, turn_started, action_resolved, battle_ended)

sub_agents.name: skill_system_developer
sub_agents.title: SkillSystem Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the SkillSystem autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Skill data registry (dictionary keyed by skill_id)
Skill execution with MP cost check and cooldown tracking
Passive skill application hooks
Skill unlock logic (level-based)

sub_agents.name: magic_system_developer
sub_agents.title: MagicSystem Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the MagicSystem autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Spell registry with all schools and tiers
Elemental affinity matrix (dictionary)
Casting logic with MP cost and range check
AoE target selection logic
Status effect application via spells

sub_agents.name: party_manager_developer
sub_agents.title: PartyManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the PartyManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Full roster management (add/remove characters)
Active party slot management (max 4)
Formation bonuses applied
Race ability application on party member init

sub_agents.name: progression_manager_developer
sub_agents.title: ProgressionManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the ProgressionManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: XP gain and level-up logic
Stat growth on level-up matching progression curve
Skill unlock on level-up
Level-up signal emitted with old level, new level, and stat deltas

sub_agents.name: inventory_manager_developer
sub_agents.title: InventoryManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the InventoryManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Item add/remove/use/equip/unequip methods
Equipment slot enforcement (weapon, armor, accessory x2)
Consumable use applying item effect
Item data registry keyed by item_id

sub_agents.name: save_load_developer
sub_agents.title: SaveLoadManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the SaveLoadManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: JSON-based save/load with 3 slot support
Saves party state, inventory, progression, and current scene
Load correctly restores all serialized state
Error handling for missing or corrupt save files

sub_agents.name: dialogue_system_developer
sub_agents.title: DialogueSystem Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the DialogueSystem autoload and scene runner GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Dialogue data loaded from JSON files
Branching dialogue with flag-gated options
Speaker name and portrait lookup
Signals for dialogue_started, line_advanced, choice_made, dialogue_ended

sub_agents.name: quest_manager_developer
sub_agents.title: QuestManager Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the QuestManager autoload GDScript for Godot 4.
completion_criteria: Quest state machine: inactive, active, completed, failed
Objective tracking with completion flags
Quest log signal emitted on state change
Quest rewards (XP, gold, items) dispatched on completion

sub_agents.name: battle_scene_developer
sub_agents.title: BattleScene Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the BattleScene Godot scene (.tscn) and its controller script.
completion_criteria: Scene node tree defined in .tscn format
HUD nodes for party HP/MP bars, enemy HP bars, action menu
Turn indicator and animation placeholder nodes
Script attached implementing _ready and connecting BattleManager signals

sub_agents.name: world_map_developer
sub_agents.title: WorldMap Scene Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the WorldMap Godot scene (.tscn) and controller script.
completion_criteria: Scene node tree with TileMap layer, player character node, camera
Location markers for at least 6 named world regions
Travel triggers that load the target scene
Random encounter trigger logic

sub_agents.name: hud_developer
sub_agents.title: HUD Scene Developer
sub_agents.description: Implement the HUD Godot scene (.tscn) and its controller script.
completion_criteria: CanvasLayer-based HUD with HP/MP bars per active party member
Active quest tracker overlay
Menu button and pause trigger
Script connected to PartyManager signals for live updates

sub_agents.name: phase_3_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 3 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 3 GDScript files and scenes for code quality, integration correctness, and completeness. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 12 Phase 3 files reviewed
No undefined variable references or missing signal connections noted
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 4 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Produce the complete art direction documentation and asset specifications. Six focused sub-agents each produce one art artifact.

sub_agents.name: art_style_guide_agent
sub_agents.title: Art Style Guide Author
sub_agents.description: Write the master Art Style Guide covering palette, grid, and visual conventions.
completion_criteria: Master palette defined with hex codes (maximum 32 colors)
Sprite grid spec: tile size, character sprite size, animation frame size
Zone palette variants for all 6+ world regions
Visual do/don't list for pixel art style consistency

sub_agents.name: character_sprite_specs_agent
sub_agents.title: Character Sprite Specifications Author
sub_agents.description: Write the character sprite specifications for all playable races and main party members.
completion_criteria: Sprite sheet layout defined for each race (idle, walk, run, battle stances)
Frame counts per animation listed
Palette subset per race defined
Battle sprite vs. overworld sprite distinctions noted

sub_agents.name: tileset_specs_agent
sub_agents.title: Tileset Specifications Author
sub_agents.description: Write the tileset specifications for all world zones and dungeon environments.
completion_criteria: One tileset spec per major zone (minimum 6)
Each spec lists: tile dimensions, required tiles (floor, wall, water, door, chest, etc.), and palette
Animated tile list (water ripple, torch flicker, etc.)
Collision layer conventions defined

sub_agents.name: ui_art_specs_agent
sub_agents.title: UI Art Specifications Author
sub_agents.description: Write the UI art specifications for all game screens and HUD elements.
completion_criteria: Battle UI: action menu, HP/MP bars, turn indicator, enemy target reticle
Menu UI: main menu, pause menu, inventory screen, equipment screen
HUD elements: overworld minimap, quest tracker, dialogue box
Font choice and size guidelines for pixel art legibility

sub_agents.name: vfx_specs_agent
sub_agents.title: VFX & Spell Effect Specifications Author
sub_agents.description: Write the VFX and spell effect animation specifications.
completion_criteria: One VFX spec per elemental school (6 total)
Each spec includes: particle color palette, animation style, frame count, and trigger timing
Hit flash and status effect indicator specs included
Screen shake and UI feedback specs included

sub_agents.name: phase_4_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 4 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 4 art documents for completeness, style consistency, and implementability. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 5 Phase 4 documents reviewed
No palette conflicts or undefined sprite dimensions
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 5 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Compose and catalog all music tracks and SFX for the game. Five focused sub-agents each produce one audio artifact.

sub_agents.name: music_track_list_agent
sub_agents.title: Music Track List Author
sub_agents.description: Write the complete music track list with mood, instrumentation, and loop points.
completion_criteria: Minimum 16 named tracks
Each track has: name, zone/context, mood, instrumentation style, BPM, and loop note
Covers: main menu, town, dungeon, world map, battle, boss battle, victory, game over, and cutscene tracks
Chiptune/orchestral hybrid style noted per track

sub_agents.name: sfx_library_agent
sub_agents.title: SFX Library Author
sub_agents.description: Write the complete SFX library with trigger mappings.
completion_criteria: SFX list with minimum 40 entries
Each entry has: name, trigger event, category (UI/combat/ambient/foley), and description
Trigger mappings link each SFX to a specific code event or scene action
Elemental magic SFX per school

sub_agents.name: audio_bus_layout_agent
sub_agents.title: Godot AudioBus Layout Author
sub_agents.description: Write the Godot 4 AudioBus layout specification with bus hierarchy and reverb profiles.
completion_criteria: AudioBus tree defined: Master -> Music, SFX, Voice, Ambient
Reverb/echo profile per zone type (dungeon, town, outdoor, battle)
Volume slider groupings for player preferences
AudioStreamPlayer node naming conventions for code integration

sub_agents.name: audio_implementation_guide_agent
sub_agents.title: Audio Implementation Guide Author
sub_agents.description: Write the audio implementation guide for the Core Developer to integrate audio into Godot 4.
completion_criteria: GDScript examples for play_music, stop_music, play_sfx functions
AudioManager autoload skeleton with all required methods stubbed
Streaming vs. preloaded audio guidance
Crossfade and music layering patterns

sub_agents.name: phase_5_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 5 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 5 audio documents for completeness and implementability. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 4 Phase 5 documents reviewed
No missing trigger mappings or unnamed audio contexts
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 6 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Write and execute comprehensive test plans. Five focused sub-agents each produce one testing artifact.

sub_agents.name: combat_test_plan_agent
sub_agents.title: Combat Test Plan Author
sub_agents.description: Write the comprehensive combat system test plan.
completion_criteria: Minimum 25 test cases for combat mechanics
Each test case has: ID, name, precondition, steps, expected result, and pass/fail field
Covers: turn order, damage calc, status effects, skill use, magic use, victory, defeat, and edge cases
At least 5 edge case tests (max level, zero HP, full MP, etc.)

sub_agents.name: progression_test_plan_agent
sub_agents.title: Progression & Inventory Test Plan Author
sub_agents.description: Write the test plan for progression, party management, and inventory systems.
completion_criteria: Minimum 20 test cases covering leveling, stat growth, skill unlock, and item use
Save/load round-trip test included
Equipment slot enforcement tests included
XP overflow edge case test included

sub_agents.name: world_navigation_test_plan_agent
sub_agents.title: World Navigation Test Plan Author
sub_agents.description: Write the test plan for world navigation, scene transitions, and quest flow.
completion_criteria: Minimum 15 test cases covering world map traversal and scene loading
Quest start, objective completion, and reward grant tests
Dialogue branch test cases
Fast travel unlock test included

sub_agents.name: regression_test_suite_agent
sub_agents.title: Regression Test Suite Author
sub_agents.description: Write the regression test suite and bug report template.
completion_criteria: Prioritized smoke test list (10 highest-priority tests from all plans)
Bug report template with: ID, severity, title, repro steps, expected vs. actual, screenshot field
Regression checklist for post-fix re-testing
Known issue log template

sub_agents.name: phase_6_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 6 QA Review
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 6 test documents for coverage completeness and quality. Output a structured PASS/FAIL report.
completion_criteria: All 4 Phase 6 documents reviewed
Total test case count >= 60 across all plans
No critical mechanic left untested
Overall phase verdict is PASS or FAIL with mandatory fixes listed
Phase 7 may not begin unless overall verdict is PASS

phases.description: Configure export pipeline, write release materials, and deliver the post-launch plan. Five focused sub-agents each produce one launch artifact.

sub_agents.name: export_config_agent
sub_agents.title: Godot Export Config Author
sub_agents.description: Write the Godot 4 export preset configuration for all target platforms.
completion_criteria: Export presets for: Windows (64-bit), Linux (64-bit), macOS (Universal), and HTML5/Web
Each preset includes: renderer, resolution, texture compression, and required flags
Web export notes: SharedArrayBuffer, COOP/COEP headers, and itch.io embed settings
Icon and splash screen asset requirements listed

sub_agents.name: launch_checklist_agent
sub_agents.title: Launch Checklist Author
sub_agents.description: Write the 100+ item pre-launch checklist.
completion_criteria: 100+ checklist items organized by category (build, content, audio, legal, store, QA)
Each item has a checkbox, owner role, and priority (P0/P1/P2)
P0 items are blockers -- cannot ship without
Store page copy requirements listed as checklist items

sub_agents.name: store_page_agent
sub_agents.title: Store Page Copy Author
sub_agents.description: Write the complete itch.io store page copy.
completion_criteria: Game title, tagline, and short description (150 chars max)
Long description (500+ words) with feature highlights and lore hook
Tag list (15+ relevant itch.io tags)
Screenshots/GIF placeholder list with captions
Content rating and accessibility notes

sub_agents.name: release_notes_agent
sub_agents.title: Release Notes & Roadmap Author
sub_agents.description: Write the v1.0.0 release notes and post-launch roadmap.
completion_criteria: v1.0.0 release notes with what's included, known issues, and platform notes
SemVer versioning scheme defined
v1.1 and v1.2 post-launch roadmap with planned features
Community feedback and bug report channel links placeholder

sub_agents.name: phase_7_qa_agent
sub_agents.title: Phase 7 QA Review -- Final Studio Sign-Off
sub_agents.description: Review all Phase 7 documents and deliver the final studio sign-off. This is the terminal quality gate for the entire workflow.
completion_criteria: All 4 Phase 7 documents reviewed
Cross-phase consistency check: store page matches game features in GDD
Final PASS verdict required to authorize release
Sign-off includes: reviewer role, date, version, and quality score summary across all phases
